description: A trident with riptide III at the bottom of a two-deep pool (x 0 to 10): held too briefly (nothing); held 12 ticks looking east, launching along the look into the pool's east wall (the wall ends the spin); back at the west side looking up (pitch -60) from the bottom, launched up out of the water (lifted 1.2 first, being on the ground), spinning (the server's flag gives the spin pose) and falling back; then wearing an elytra, launched up again and pressing jump in the air to glide down steeply (pitch 45).

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
